choice: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
rationale: Expansion of the user-supplied disease name

choice: Directly mapped COPD traits are core; related respiratory phenotypes remain separate
rationale: Prevents phenotype dilution while retaining biologically relevant context

choice: GRCh38
rationale: Matches shared reference assets; source builds and lift-over will be documented

choice: Core requires the primary mapped URI set to contain only MONDO:0005002 or legacy EFO:0000341
rationale: Prevents COPD-plus-smoking, biomarker, comorbidity, and interaction associations from inflating core counts

choice: ENCODE severe-emphysema donor ENCDO520EJG, analyzed by matched lung lobe
rationale: Provides disease-relevant, donor-matched ATAC, H3K27ac, and H3K27me3; normal adult lung and fibroblast retained for sensitivity analysis

choice: Use the local 1000 Genomes Phase 3 20190312 GRCh38 remap directly
rationale: GWAS Catalog focal coordinates and downstream regulatory resources are GRCh38; direct matching avoids liftOver loss and the shared workspace contains no GRCh37 panel

choice: Assign only discovery-stage study-supported AFR/AMR/EAS/EUR/SAS panels; accept exact coordinate/allele, unique positional-only when allele is missing, or unique +/-1-bp indel-anchor/allele matches
rationale: Prevents default-EUR assignment and silent inclusion of coordinate-neighbor or allele-discordant variants

choice: Preliminary enhancer is H3K27ac; preliminary silencer is H3K27me3; refined elements are same-lobe ATAC peaks overlapping the corresponding mark by at least 1 bp
rationale: Implements both framework definitions while preserving donor and anatomical matching

choice: Use one exact, unambiguous GENCODE v50 gene record plus 100,000 bp on each side; exclude Y_RNA, GUSBP5, and CYP2B7P because exact symbols map to multiple records
rationale: Prevents arbitrary coordinate assignment and makes the operational flank explicit

choice: Merge overlapping or book-ended same-definition intervals across the three lobes
rationale: Counts distinct covered regulatory regions rather than summing repeated lobe-specific peak calls

choice: Do not remove promoter-overlapping or ENCODE-blacklisted peaks from the Section 3 descriptive burden counts
rationale: Preserves released ENCODE calls; downstream model controls and candidate QC apply their own exclusions

choice: Require at least 1 bp of GRCh38 BED overlap; retain all source candidate records; assign NA_not_bed_eligible rather than false to feature flags for the three unlocalized tags
rationale: Prevents loss of unresolved Catalog tags and distinguishes untested coordinates from tested non-overlap

choice: Report preliminary, refined, and comprehensive precedence schemes with bed-ineligible records separated; in the comprehensive scheme use coding CDS, refined enhancer, refined silencer, preliminary enhancer, preliminary silencer, other known regulatory, RepeatMasker, then other
rationale: Produces auditable complete partitions while retaining all mutually nonexclusive source flags; precedence is a reporting convention rather than biological rank

decision: Candidate reporting units and ancestry provenance
choice: Use unique reference records as the primary unit, add a 660-tag-identifier view, report GWS-tag and LD-proxy roles separately, and retain AFR/AMR/EAS/EUR/SAS proxy-panel strata as overlapping memberships
rationale: Avoids conflating eight shared-reference tag pairs or treating overlapping tag/proxy and panel strata as additive independent groups

choice: Analyze the 140 single-record GENCODE v50 mappings; compare with 70,016 unique-name canonical-chromosome genes sampled within exact gene biotype; define operational loci as gene body plus 100 kb per side
rationale: Excludes three ambiguous gene-name mappings and controls the major length/chromosome differences among the eight observed gene biotypes

choice: Score UCSC hg38 phyloP100way and phastCons100way over GENCODE gene bodies using mean0 and report coverage separately
rationale: Provides complementary evolutionary-rate and conserved-element measures while making missing-track treatment explicit

choice: Retain positive direct Open Targets MONDO associations; exclude COPD, its ontology ancestors/descendants, and explicit COPD/emphysema/chronic-bronchitis/bronchiectasis label matches
rationale: Avoids circular COPD and subtype evidence while retaining a fully auditable broad other-disease inventory

choice: Train separate enhancer and silencer models from the three-lobe union for ENCDO520EJG severe-emphysema bulk lung
rationale: Provides matched ATAC, H3K27ac, and H3K27me3 while keeping the single-donor limitation explicit

choice: Use chr1-6,10-22,X,Y for training, chr7 validation, chr8-9 test; exact 1:2 overall positive-control sampling with seed 20261001
rationale: Matches the framework and prevents same-chromosome leakage into held-out calibration

choice: Require a model region score at its held-out 5% FPR threshold plus absolute allele delta at or above the 95th percentile within SNV or indel-complex background; exclude blacklist
rationale: Combines independently calibrated element prediction with unusually large matched-class allelic perturbation

choice: Test model-specific JASPAR matches with TF-MoDISco q <= 0.05; call a site at relative two-strand PWM score >=0.8 and creation or disruption only on allele threshold crossing
rationale: Provides an auditable sequence heuristic while avoiding claims of measured TF occupancy

choice: Use the maximum exact ALT frequency across AFR, AMR, EAS, EUR, and SAS; common >=0.05, low-frequency >=0.01 and <0.05, rare <0.01; strict population-specific requires >=0.01 in one and <0.001 in all others
rationale: Uses recalculated genotype counts and makes the population-specific rule deliberately stringent

choice: Report proximity, GWAS-linked, locus-membership, and CDS hypotheses as provisional; do not infer a target without matched-donor contact or molecular evidence
rationale: No severe-emphysema donor rE2G or HiChIP map was available

choice: Use exact chromosome-position-REF-ALT significant GTEx v10 Lung pairs and round-trip-audited MPRAbase containment or exact candidate-rsID metadata
rationale: Separates variant-level molecular association from regional assay coverage and prevents source-tag substitution

choice: Keep GTEx variant-level, MPRAbase regional, and HGNC/Open Targets gene-context evidence separate; preserve Section 4 ranks
rationale: Contextual gene association and broad proximity must not inflate independent variant-validation counts

choice: Select 12 candidates with at most one per transitive shared linked-tag/source-focal component; cover eligible evidence strata, then fill by unchanged Section 4 rank
rationale: Reduces linked-tag redundancy while preserving the prespecified computational priority and ensuring assay-relevant diversity

choice: Generate REF and ALT genomic inserts in both orientations with 100 GRCh38 reference-sequence bases on each side; do not add phased haplotypes, platform-specific adapters, barcodes, promoters, or restriction-site remediation
rationale: The design isolates one nominated allele; the receiving laboratory must consider relevant native haplotypes and finalize an ordering-ready architecture for its platform

choice: Label all candidate and TF plans proposed_not_performed and require genotype-verified endogenous allele perturbation before allele-level causal support
rationale: Computational prediction, MPRA, CRISPRi, and motif evidence answer different questions and cannot be conflated

choice: Present the output as an auditable candidate-nomination and experimental-testing framework, not identification of 337 causal variants
rationale: LD expansion, one-donor model prediction, molecular association, regional reporter coverage, and planned experiments do not establish causality

choice: Keep the internally audited draft explicitly not submission-ready until human authors supply declarations, institutional ethics wording, journal-specific disclosure, and a persistent archive
rationale: The computational workflow cannot infer author identity, institutional determinations, conflicts, funding, consent, or public-deposit metadata
